title: make repin leaves the viewer's ui pin where it is
foundBy: user report (host): "is make repin also repinning the npm dependency on the ui npm package in the ledger, tracer and campaign projects?"

evidence.verified: In a clean clone of main with the change, `make repin` moved the viewer's ui pin to ui's last build and rebuilt both committed viewer builds, and `make ci` then passed. `make -n repin` moved no pin. ci runs 35957447340 and 35958977088 passed on the two commits.

resolution: `make repin` moves the viewer's `@codesweep-ai/ui` pin to the npm version of ui's last build, through `scripts/repin-npm.mjs`, and rebuilds the committed viewer on it. Where the status file lists no npm version yet, it takes the version the build's npm image carries. A pin whose project lists no build stays where it is.
details: `make repin` moves the codesweep-ai tools in `go.mod` to the last commit each one's CI built, and stops there. The viewer's `@codesweep-ai/ui` pin in `apps/viewer/package.json` stays where it was set by hand. It moves only through oss-repin, which needs every sibling checked out beside this one. A clone of this repository alone has no way to take ui's last build.
